adaptation.tokens: CDS surfaces, clay, borders, radii, shadows and system font fallbacks mapped to --omd-*; readable secondary/status colors and native font sizing retained.
adaptation.layout: Visual adaptation on existing DSH REA components. Native editors, IME, attachment, sending, tool execution, disclosures, scrolling, window controls and accessibility remain host-owned.
adaptation.assets: No proprietary fonts, audio or upstream application binaries included.
adaptation.interaction: CDS button spring, control sizes, menu/dialog elevation, model and effort presentation, attachments, reasoning and tool/approval styling. DSH owns actual models, upload/retry, permissions, range values, disclosure choices and underlying actions.
adaptation.scroll: CDS scroll timeline/property and nonlinear mask rules are namespaced in scroll.css on existing input, process, model, settings and attachment scrollports; conversation pinning and virtualized transcript geometry stay native.
adaptation.split: Native pointer capture and width solver plus a 4px dead zone, Escape rollback, double-click balanced right pane/default sidebar, keyboard adjustment and iframe shielding. Native width constraints and docking policy remain.
adaptation.media: Affine cursor-anchor zoom, natural-size upper bound (at least 2x), 1.05 snap, 1.25 controls and 0.01 wheel sensitivity adapted onto the authorized native single-image lightbox. Untransformed base geometry and fixed drag origin avoid compounded scale/translation. Native close, loader and focus remain; no cross-session gallery aggregation.
adaptation.lifecycle: Active appearance owner only. Gesture listeners, Resize/MutationObservers, media transforms, pointer capture, inert state and attributes release on theme change/unload.
adaptation.retained: DSH IME/composer, message rendering and copy confirmation, reasoning folding, tool/approval semantics, original text, scheduling, model/Ultra state, scroll following and desktop titlebar. No Claude account quotas, hardcoded model tiers, Cowork backend, voice/audio or proprietary variable fonts are introduced.
